SELECT COMPANY_ID COMPANYID, COMPANY_CODE COMPANYCODE, COMPANY_SHORT_NAME COMPANYSHORTNAME, COMPANY_FULL_NAME COMPANYFULLNAME, COMPANY_TYPE COMPANYTYPE, ( SELECT COMPANY_FULL_NAME FROM fnd_company FC2 WHERE FC2.COMPANY_ID = FC.PARENT_COMPANY_ID ) AS parentCompanyName, ENABLED_FLAG enabledFlag FROM fnd_company FC
AND FC.COMPANY_CODE LIKE concat('%',concat(#{companyCode}, '%'))
AND FC.COMPANY_SHORT_NAME LIKE concat('%',concat(#{companyShortName}, '%'))
AND FC.COMPANY_FULL_NAME LIKE concat('%',concat(#{companyFullName}, '%'))
AND FC.COMPANY_TYPE = companyType)
AND FC.PARENT_COMPANY_ID = #{parentCompanyId}

SELECT COMPANY_ID companyId, COMPANY_CODE companyCode, COMPANY_SHORT_NAME companyShortName, COMPANY_FULL_NAME companyFullName, COMPANY_TYPE companyType, ENTERPRISE_UNIFIED_CREDIT_CODE enterpriseUnifiedCreditCode, REGISTERED_CAPITAL registeredCapital, LEGAL_REPRESENTATIVE legalRepresentative, ESTABLISHMENT_DATE establishmentDate, OPERATING_PERIOD_FROM operatingPeriodFrom, OPERATING_PERIOD_TO operatingPeriodTo, BASIC_ACCOUNT_BANK basicAccountBank, BASIC_ACCOUNT_NUMBER basicAccountNumber, CONTACT_PERSON contactPerson, PHONE, FAX, ADDRESS, BUSINESS_SCOPE businessScope, ZIPCODE, ( SELECT COMPANY_FULL_NAME FROM fnd_company FC2 WHERE FC2.COMPANY_ID = FC.PARENT_COMPANY_ID ) AS parentCompanyName FROM fnd_company FC WHERE FC.COMPANY_ID = #{companyId}

select fc.*,nvl(fca.authority_rule_flag,'N') as authorityRuleFlag, (SELECT c.currency_name FROM fnd_currency c where c.currency_code = fc.currency)currency_n, (select fc1.company_full_name from fnd_company fc1 where fc1.company_id=fc.parent_company_id) parent_company_name_n, (select fc1.company_full_name from fnd_company fc1 where fc1.company_id=fc.parent_company_id) parent_company_name, cba.bank_branch_name, cba.bank_account_num, cba.bank_account_name, (select gfa.set_of_books_id from gld_financial_attribute gfa where gfa.company_id = fc.company_id) set_of_books_id, (select gsob.set_of_books_name from gld_financial_attribute gfa, gld_set_of_books gsob where gfa.company_id = fc.company_id and gsob.set_of_books_id = gfa.set_of_books_id) set_of_books_id_n, (select gas.account_set_name from gld_financial_attribute gfa, gld_set_of_books gsob, gld_account_set gas where gfa.company_id = fc.company_id and gsob.set_of_books_id = gfa.set_of_books_id) account_set_id_n, (select s.meaning from gld_financial_attribute gfa, gld_set_of_books gsob, sys_code_value_b_v s where gfa.company_id = fc.company_id and gsob.set_of_books_id = gfa.set_of_books_id and s.code = 'CHS.CURRENCY_TYPE' and s.code_value = gsob.functional_currency) functional_currency_n
from fnd_company fc left join fnd_company_attribute fca on fc.company_id = fca.company_id left join csh_bank_account cba on cba.bank_account_id = fc.bank_account_id
and fc.company_id = #{companyId}
and fc.company_code like concat(concat('%',#{companyCode} ),'%')
and fc.company_full_name like concat(concat('%',#{companyFullName} ),'%')
and fc.enabled_flag= #{enabledFlag}
order by fc.company_id
